title: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to establish a PDU session, which is accepted by the network.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the SMF to the UE to accept the PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: Authorized QoS rules
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message containing the authorized QoS rules for the PDU session.

entities.name: Authorized QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message containing the authorized QoS flow descriptions for the PDU session.

entities.name: Selected SSC mode
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message indicating the selected session and service continuity mode.

entities.name: Selected PDU session type
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message indicating the selected PDU session type (e.g., IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6).

entities.name: Mapped EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message containing EPS bearer contexts mapped from QoS flows for interworking with EPS.

entities.name: Always-on PDU session indication
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message indicating whether the PDU session is always-on.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message indicating the cause for session establishment acceptance or restrictions.

entities.name: T3580
entities.description: Timer started by the UE during PDU session establishment procedure; stopped upon receipt of PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT.

entities.name: PDU session established
entities.description: State entered by the UE after successfully receiving PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition indicating the PDU session is for emergency services, affecting QoS and SSC mode selection.

entities.name: Store authorized QoS rules
entities.description: Behavior where the UE stores the authorized QoS rules from the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

relations.description: The procedure includes the SMF sending the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.
The message contains the Authorized QoS rules IE.
The message may contain the Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE.
The message contains the Selected SSC mode IE.
The message contains the Selected PDU session type IE.
The message may contain the Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE for interworking with EPS.
The message may contain the Always-on PDU session indication IE.
The message may contain the 5GSM cause IE to indicate restrictions.
Receipt of the message stops timer T3580.
Receipt of the message establishes the PDU session as established.
If the PDU session is emergency, the Selected SSC mode IE is set to SSC mode 1.
The UE stores the authorized QoS rules from the message.
